title: Display days are calendar-based; lookback/reachback are elapsed UTC durations
answers: How are timezone and DST handled in marketing session precompute window
Should attribution lookback use calendar days or timedelta
Tests for precompute window with timezones
body:
In precompute_window_start (products/marketing_analytics/backend/hogql_queries/marketing_sessions_precompute.py): PRECOMPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS is subtracted in the team's local calendar (midnight, then `.astimezone(UTC)`), while attribution_window_days and SESSION_READ_REACHBACK_DAYS are subtracted as UTC `timedelta` after conversion, so they stay elapsed durations across DST.
- Changing the boundary does not change the writer query, job hashes or CHUNK_DAYS, so existing ready daily jobs stay reusable; the warmer only fills missing oldest windows.
- Tests use `time_machine.travel(now, tick=False)` with parameterized timezones (UTC, America/Los_Angeles, Pacific/Auckland) and DST dates: products/marketing_analytics/backend/hogql_queries/test_attribution_sessions_read.py and products/marketing_analytics/dags/tests/test_marketing_sessions_precompute.py. Patch PRECOMPUTE_WINDOW_DAYS in the backend module (the dag module no longer needs it).
- Docs: docs/internal/marketing-attribution-session-precompute.md must be updated with boundary changes.
